description: Benchmark: failure, recovery, and corruption detection.

checks.description: A truncated STEP file is either refused with a typed AdapterFailure, or (measured engine behavior: lazy STEP parsing) it opens 'successfully' as a SILENTLY PARTIAL model and the ADAPTER's structural validation detects the partial state (wall count < expected). Engine-side truncation detection is absent — the adapter MUST validate structure: an explicit operational constraint for the worker boundary.
After the malformed-truncated failure, a valid IFC open succeeds in the same process (failed-operation recovery).
A garbage-byte file is refused with a typed AdapterFailure(malformed_input).

details.message: engine refused to open IFC file: Unable to parse IFC SPF header
details.cause: Error('Unable to parse IFC SPF header')

checks.description: After the malformed-garbage failure, a valid IFC open succeeds in the same process (failed-operation recovery).
A file with an unsupported schema header is refused with a typed AdapterFailure (or the engine rejects the unsupported schema) — never a silent mis-parse.

details.message: engine refused to open IFC file: Unsupported schema: IFC9X_RC

checks.description: After the malformed-wrong-schema failure, a valid IFC open succeeds in the same process (failed-operation recovery).
A dangling entity reference is either typed by the adapter or explicitly recorded as tolerated by the engine's lazy entity resolution — the outcome is a recorded datum, never a silent corruption.
After the malformed-dangling-ref failure, a valid IFC open succeeds in the same process (failed-operation recovery).
OCCT rejects a degenerate (zero-height) primitive with a typed Standard_DomainError — the failure mode is a typed engine exception, never a silent bad solid.
The adapter boundary converts engine geometry exceptions into typed AdapterFailure(engine_error, recoverable) — the LOCK-003 adapter contract obligation exercised on a real engine failure.
A face-only (solid-degenerate) shape reports zero volume — the failure mode is detected by the quantity path, not silently priced.
After the degenerate-tool rejection and adapter typing, a valid complex boolean succeeds in the same process.
A corrupted on-disk IFC artifact is detected by the engine (on open or on use) or its tolerance is recorded as an explicit datum — silent corruption is never assumed away.

Corrupted STEP artifacts: NUL-byte corruption mid-file is TOLERATED by the OCCT reader (recorded datum — silent tolerance), while truncation is REFUSED with a typed IFSelect_RetFail. Artifact validation therefore cannot rely on the reader alone — checksums at the Offisos artifact boundary are required (operational constraint).

details.note: NUL tolerance is the honest recorded engine behavior; the durable-write + checksum layer at the adapter boundary is the detection mechanism for it

checks.description: A corrupted FCStd artifact reopen attempt inside the isolated engine process is recorded: FreeCAD either refuses it or reports the failure — the subprocess isolates the parent from the failure either way.
The durable-write pattern (temp file + atomic rename) preserves the original artifact when the writer dies mid-write: the target is untouched and the partial write lives only in the temp file.
The commit step is atomic: after os.replace the target holds the complete new artifact and the temp file is gone.
